title: When the Bell Turns
author: L. M. Villalobos
blurb: Lior Thackeray, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
